passages.hieroglyphs: One of the world’s earliest writing systems was developed by the ancient Egyptians around 3000 BC using pictures called hieroglyphs. Hieroglyph sym____ can repr_____ both conc____ and sou___. The im___ that rese_____ an e__ has the mea____ of lis___ and corre______ to the consonants j, d, and n. These multiple layers of significance made it extremely difficult for modern linguists to understand hieroglyphs. The script remained a mystery until 1822, when researchers finally deciphered it by studying an artifact called the Rosetta Stone, which included the exact same text in both hieroglyphs and Greek letters.

questions.prompt: Question 11: complete sym____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：bols → symbols。symbolsは「記号」。can representの主語で、複数の象形文字の記号を指します。

questions.prompt: Question 12: complete repr_____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：esent → represent。canの後ろなので動詞の原形represent。「表す」という意味です。

questions.prompt: Question 13: complete conc____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：epts → concepts。both concepts and soundsは「概念と音の両方」。後文の複数の意味の層に対応します。

questions.prompt: Question 14: complete sou___. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：nds → sounds。soundsは「音」。記号が概念だけでなく発音も表すという対比です。

questions.prompt: Question 15: complete im___. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：age → image。The imageは「その図像」。後ろの関係節that resembles an earがどの図像かを説明します。

questions.prompt: Question 16: complete rese_____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：mbles → resembles。単数のimageを受けるのでresembles。「耳に似ている」という意味です。

questions.prompt: Question 17: complete e__. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ar → ear。an earは「耳」。earは母音の音から始まるのでanが使われています。

questions.prompt: Question 18: complete mea____. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ning → meaning。the meaning ofは「〜という意味」。図像が表す内容を述べています。

questions.prompt: Question 19: complete lis___. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：ten → listen。listenは「聞く」。原本のlis＋3文字に一致します。ofの後はその語の意味を指しており、listeningを入れると原本の文字数に合いません。

questions.prompt: Question 20: complete corre______. Enter the missing letters.
questions.answer: 正解：sponds → corresponds。corresponds toは「〜に対応する」。The imageが単数なので三人称単数形です。後続の子音表記j, d, and nは原本通り保持しています。
